verdict.rationale: The core HTML API scrapes one URL per call, so the API itself does not cover a whole-site crawl. Site-wide crawling appears only through the official CLI's `scrapingbee crawl` command, documented as a quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl or Scrapy-project spider. That command is described in a single line, with no detail on how much of the site it covers, page limits or how results are aggregated. Missing for 10: a single-request crawl endpoint in the API, documentation of crawl depth, limits and output aggregation, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the CLI crawl returns content from all pages.
